WorkSync 0.2.0 brings your personal work into the app, lets copies of a
project be merged back together, and is now fully in Japanese.

## Download

| System                    | File                              |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| Windows (64-bit)          | `WorkSync-win32-x64-0.2.0.zip`    |
| macOS (Apple silicon)     | `WorkSync-darwin-arm64-0.2.0.zip` |
| Linux (no install)        | `WorkSync-linux-x64-0.2.0.zip`    |
| Linux, Debian or Ubuntu   | `worksync_0.2.0_amd64.deb`        |
| Linux, Fedora or openSUSE | `worksync-0.2.0-1.x86_64.rpm`     |

- **Windows:** unzip into a folder on a local drive and run `worksync.exe`.
  Nothing is installed. To update, unzip the new version in the same place as
  the old one: your data is in the `WorkSync-data` folder next to it and stays.
- **macOS:** unzip and move `WorkSync.app` to Applications.
- **Linux:** unzip and run `worksync`, or install the package.

The builds aren't code signed yet, so Windows and macOS warn the first time.
See [Download and run](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync#download-and-run)
for how to open the app anyway. Your data from 0.1.0 is kept and upgraded; a
backup is made first.

## New

- **Merge copies of a project.** When someone sends back their copy, choose
  Import a project and then Merge. WorkSync adds what only one of you changed
  and asks you, one question at a time, only where you both changed the same
  thing: two cards to pick from, the newer one suggested. Situation updates from
  both go into the history by date, and notes merge line by line, with Keep
  both and a preview. A backup is made first. Copies made with 0.1.0 can't be
  merged: export and import them once with 0.2.0.
- **My tasks:** your own to-dos, outside any project, with reminders.
- **Notes:** on their own or attached to a project, with tags, favorites, links
  and pasted images. Click an image to see it at actual size and zoom.
- **Catalog:** the apps, files and folders you open often, with their own
  icons, Everything search on Windows, and a quick-search shortcut from any app.
- **Japanese:** WorkSync's own screens in English or Japanese, following your
  system by default; messages and task history too.
- **The app:** its own glass title bar and icon, light, dark or system theme,
  keep running in the tray, the full text of anything cut short when you point
  at it, and the whole task history in its own window.

## Better

- Deadlines and "Overdue" keep up while the app stays open, past midnight too.
- Deleting asks first, everywhere.
- Screens fit smaller windows, and dialogs keep their buttons in view.
- Exports say how many project notes go along.

Please report problems on the
[Issues page](https://github.com/KelvinNguyen97/WorkSync/issues).
